game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: Gigagamer67
quote: GTA 6 – The $100 Girlfriend Chore SimulatorAt this point, Rockstar could release a microwave with a GTA logo and gaming influencers would give it a 10/10  The pricing is beyond ridiculous, physical buyers are getting hit with missing or unusable codes, and good luck getting Rockstar to actually help you. Performance is another L, with terrible frame rates and bugs making the whole experience feel unfinished. Then there’s the subscription nonsense, because apparently paying for the game doesn’t mean you actually own access to everything, even in single-player. Most of the gameplay feels like babysitting NPCs, completing random chores, and spending 10–15 minutes driving back and forth between missions just to make the map look impressive on paper. The story isn’t doing itself any favors either, with some genuinely questionable writing and completely unbalanced character decisions. And don’t even get me started on the driving; even with upgraded cars, everything feels like you’re steering a shopping cart on ice.
